Test image: mango leaf with necrotic brown/tan lesions concentrated at the tip and upper portion, with irregular edges. The leaf body is otherwise mostly green. The damage appears tip-focused with dry, papery necrotic tissue.

Now let me view one reference from each class.
Anthracnose ref 1: Heavily yellowed/browned leaf, mostly uniform discoloration, severe tip necrosis. Quite different from test image which retains more green.
Die_Back ref 1: Completely desiccated, dark brown/gray shriveled leaf — entirely dead, no green tissue. Very different from test image.
Powdery_Mildew ref 1: White powdery/dusty spots scattered across the leaf surface — very different from test image which has tip necrosis, not powdery coating.

Sooty_Mould ref 1: Dark black/greenish sooty coating all over leaf — very different from test image.

The test image doesn't match Powdery_Mildew, Sooty_Mould, or Die_Back well. Anthracnose is the best candidate so far since it shows tip/margin necrosis. Let me view more Anthracnose references and also a second Die_Back reference.
Anthracnose ref 2: Green leaf with dark brown/black irregular lesions mid-leaf. The test image has lighter tan/brown tip necrosis. Let me check another Anthracnose and Die_Back.
Die_Back ref 2: Fully brown/dried dead leaf, no green. Let me check the third Die_Back and more references.
I've viewed all 12 references. I need 4 more views to reach the budget of 16. Let me revisit the most relevant ones for final comparison.

All 16 views complete. Summary of comparison:

- **Anthracnose**: Green leaves with dark/brown irregular necrotic lesions — closest to test image
- **Die_Back**: Fully desiccated brown/gray dead leaves — no green tissue, very different
- **Powdery_Mildew**: White powdery coating scattered across leaf surface — different symptom type
- **Sooty_Mould**: Dark black sooty patches — different symptom type

The test image shows a mostly green mango leaf with brown/tan dry necrotic lesions at the tip and scattered smaller lesions on the body. This best matches the Anthracnose pattern (green leaf + irregular brown necrotic lesions), as seen in refs Mango_Leaf_24 and Mango_Leaf_383.
